header.name: GNN3R data set (g2r inputs, rebuilt D1PAIR pairs with the B' c3 fix, cr2 labels) and GNN3 model

rules.D-3 labels: cr2 ($LAD/labels_d1_cr2.json); dd_t = y_t(a) - y_t(b) for the 10 labels of d1pair_common.D1_TCOL
rules.D-4 row exclusion: none by label value; no in_P_feat filter
rules.D-5 B' c3: Bp need rows: C4's methyl is the reference substituent (rowattr_r.c3_orientation_bp)
rules.D-6 pair rules: d1_pairs.build / d1_anchor_pairs.build (unchanged); F = (dipole, skeleton, series, cfg, orient, face, c3)
rules.D-7 anchor b: Xb Me < CO2Me < tBu < CHO < Ts < NMe2 < rest, then p < m < o < direct, Xb, job_id
rules.D-9 folds: T1 core -> fold of analysis/d1_pair/results/S_folds.csv; -1 always train; inner = first GroupKFold(4) by core
rules.D-10 sets: in_P_main = in_P_sens = reference pairs; in_T_main = every pair
rules.D-11 model: GNN3 unchanged (gnn3/gnn3/constants.py): grid {4,6} layers x {64,128} width, 5 seeds, RTX 3090

setting.rule: mode of the chosen cells (ties: lowest mean tuning validation, then grid order); n_epochs = median(best_epoch)

use_with.note: retrain from F_pairs_r.csv (sha256 in B_label_report.json); do not rebuild Phase B

reactions.fam: azomethine ylide/B/R1/c//exo/cis;azomethine ylide/B/R1/c//exo/trans;azomethine ylide/B/R1/t//exo/cis;azomethine ylide/B/R1/t//exo/trans;azomethine ylide/B/R2///exo/
carbonyl ylide/B/R1/c//endo/cis;carbonyl ylide/B/R1/c//endo/trans;carbonyl ylide/B/R1/t//endo/cis;carbonyl ylide/B/R1/t//endo/trans;carbonyl ylide/B/R2///endo/
